hints.title: Boundary Violation Detection
hints.text: Within each window of size k, identify elements that violate non-decreasing sorted order.

hints.title: Left and Right Extremes
hints.text: From left to right, track running maximums to find the rightmost violation; from right to left, track running minimums for the leftmost violation.

hints.title: Span Calculation
hints.text: If no violation is detected, return 0; otherwise, the required sort length is right - left + 1.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting every window independently adds an O(k log k) factor per step.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct prefix/suffix extremum scans require zero heap or stack memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify the leftmost and rightmost unsorted positions in linear time per window.
